purpose: Learning line for unit conversion with the unit table (years 3-m1).
details: Unit kinds grow from length/mass/capacity to area (year 5) and volume (m1); steps, digits, decimals and limits grow. Loaded by kern/leerlijnen.py (laad/parameters) which the topic's generator calls with the child's school year; checked by tests/test_leerlijnen.py and turned into the handbook tables by docs/tools/handleiding.py.

field_notes.explanation: The stored skill id this learning line belongs to; the same as the file name. Stored ids are never renamed.
A short Dutch description of the skill (shown in the handbook and reports).
Goals of the skill (a list; empty for most skills).
The parameters of this skill and their type name (lijst, int, bool, tekst, getal); a value of the leerlijn must match.
Per school year (3, 4, 5, 6, m1, m2) the parameter values; a missing or null year means the skill is not offered then (the level cannot be chosen).
How many units the decimal comma may move (steps in the unit table).
Largest number of digits of the numbers in a column sum (for unit conversion: a [min, max] pair of digits).
Decimals in the number of the question.
The number in the question stays below this.
The unit kinds that occur (lengte, massa, inhoud, oppervlakte, volume).
